assessment: This study uses Drosophila as a model to study a specific mutant in a gene encoding a nuclear pore protein, whose counterpart in human leads to a rare disease called XX-ovarian-dysgenesis. Intriguingly, the fly mutants mimic the syndromes identified in human patients, such as failures in ovary development and function. The authors use fly ovary as a model to study the reasons underlying the phenotypes, which should provide insight to our understanding of this disease.
